0022600041.text: The Sacramento Kings (1-10, 0-6 at home, 14th in the West) host the Portland Trail Blazers (8-3, 1st in the Northwest, 4th in the West), with Sacramento on a four-game losing streak and Portland on a two-game winning streak. Sacramento is without Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery) and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee), and Precious Achiuwa (lower leg bruise) is day-to-day and a game-time decision, while Portland is without Ja Morant (hamstring), Shaedon Sharpe (knee, surgery), and Vit Krejci (ankle), with Chris Youngblood (foot bruise) day-to-day and a game-time decision. The Kings trail the season series 0-1 after losing 128-120 at home on Oct. 23, and they lost all four meetings to Portland in 2025-26.
